meta_description: Grass grid paver tiles: open-cell pavers that let grass grow through, for driveways, parking bays and garden paths. Free sample on WhatsApp.
description:
These grass grid paver tiles are open-cell paving pieces from Pak Clay that let grass grow through the openings while the grid holds the surface, used for driveways, parking bays and garden access paths.

## How they look
Each tile is a grid of solid ribs around open pockets. Once the pockets are filled with soil and grass, a driveway or parking area looks mostly green, with only the edges of the grid showing. Filled with gravel instead, it gives a neat, textured surface.

## Where they work
- **Home driveways and car porches** that want a greener look.
- **Parking bays** at farmhouses, offices and schools.
- **Garden access paths and lawn edges** that get foot or light vehicle traffic.

Grass pavers for driveway use are chosen because the open cells let rainwater soak into the ground instead of running off, which is why the system is also called permeable paving.

## Good to know
- Design: open-cell grass grid
- Type: paver / tuff tile
- Category: pavers tiles
- Size, thickness and load suitability: confirm on enquiry

A compacted, well-drained base is important, and suitability depends on the load, so tell us how the area will be used before you order. Grass in the cells needs watering and sun to establish. Our guide to [driveway tiles in Pakistan](/blog/driveway-tiles-in-pakistan-pavers-grass-grid-and-stone-options) compares grass grid with solid pavers, and [car porch tiles](/blog/car-porch-tiles-in-pakistan-best-options-and-design-ideas) covers porch options.

## See it before you order
Pak Clay shows its range at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) and at G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) to see the grid in hand, then send your area, use and city for a dated quote. Compare the [octagon paver tile](/products/octagon-paver-tile), or browse all [pavers tiles](/categories/pavers-tiles).

faqs.q: What is the price of grass grid paver tiles in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the area, thickness, quantity and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Can cars park on grass grid pavers?
faqs.a: Grass grid pavers are commonly used for driveways and parking bays, but suitability depends on the tile thickness, the base and the vehicle load. Tell Pak Clay how the area will be used before ordering.

faqs.q: Grass grid pavers or solid pavers for a driveway?
faqs.a: Grass grid gives a green surface and lets rainwater drain into the ground; solid pavers give a hard, easy-to-sweep surface. Grass also needs watering and sun, so think about shade and upkeep.

faqs.q: Can I see a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with "Grass Grid Pavers" and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
